entries.title: Psalms 112:1
segments: ¶Let the Lord be praised. Happy is the man who gives honour to the Lord, and has great delight in his laws.

entries.title: Psalms 112:2
segments: His seed will be strong on the earth; blessings will be on the generation of the upright.

entries.title: Psalms 112:3
segments: A store of wealth will be in his house, and his righteousness will be for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 112:4
segments: For the upright there is a light shining in the dark; he is full of grace and pity.

entries.title: Psalms 112:5
segments: All is well for the man who is kind and gives freely to others; he will make good his cause when he is judged.

entries.title: Psalms 112:6
segments: ¶He will not ever be moved; the memory of the upright will be living for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 112:7
segments: He will have no fear of evil news; his heart is fixed, for his hope is in the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 112:8
segments: His heart is resting safely, he will have no fear, till he sees trouble come on his haters.

entries.title: Psalms 112:9
segments: He has given with open hands to the poor; his righteousness is for ever; his horn will be lifted up with honour.

entries.title: Psalms 112:10
segments: The sinner will see it with grief; he will be wasted away with envy; the desire of the evil-doers will come to nothing.
